harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now publishes the approved boot tree as a persistent, read-only TFTP root. node2 downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin byte-for-byte. Uploads and requests outside the boot root are rejected. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu 24.04-compatible tftpd-hpa on node1 and tftp-hpa on node2 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured the secure TFTP root as /srv/legacy2/tftp-firmware-distribution/boot and added a systemd ReadOnlyPaths restriction.
Enabled the TFTP service and verified its UDP/69 listener.
Verified approved downloads, SHA-256 hashes, sizes, traversal rejection, absolute-path rejection, new-upload rejection, and overwrite rejection.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually using native safe reboot scheduling, verified changed boot IDs, and retested recovery.

evidence.requirement: Publish only the approved boot tree as a read-only TFTP root
evidence.summary: Shows the enabled service, effective secure root, UDP/69 listener, persistent ReadOnlyPaths restriction, and absence of unauthorized uploaded files.

evidence.requirement: node2 downloads boot.cfg and firmware.bin without changing firmware bytes
evidence.summary: The staged and downloaded files have identical SHA-256 hashes; firmware.bin remains 40 bytes and boot.cfg 45 bytes.

evidence.requirement: Reject uploads and requests outside the boot root
evidence.summary: Traversal and absolute-path reads returned File not found; new uploads were rejected and boot.cfg overwrite returned Permission denied. Server-side evidence confirms no unauthorized file appeared and hashes remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained Ubuntu 24.04 with kernel 6.8.0-71-generic; native Ubuntu tftpd-hpa/tftp-hpa 5.2 packages are installed.

Baseline boot ID a95da956-aa3e-4fec-a746-fbb828074410, acknowledged reboot, changed boot ID cdd006d5-0789-45c3-b594-a94ba88ff6ab, then recovered service/listener/data and successful cross-node transfers with access controls intact.
Baseline boot ID 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45, acknowledged reboot, changed boot ID 61138a28-d84d-4f2b-93c7-6a8bf74ef24b, then successful byte-exact TFTP downloads and rejection tests.
